description: A bare `<` / `>` in a raw body displays as typed (`a < b`).
rationale: §4.17 (S462 Q21): a `<pre>` / `<code>` raw-content body is emitted with `<` and `>` entity-encoded — what the author typed is what the page shows and nothing in a raw body builds an element; `&` is not encoded (the author's entities still decode); a balanced, attribute-less nested `<code>` / `<pre>` stays an element.
